title: A bounded field is determined μ-a.e. by its pairings with continuous compactly supported fields in U
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^N with μ(ℝ^N ∖ U) = 0 and μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and ν, ν' : ℝ^N → ℝ^N μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ν| ≤ 1 and |ν'| ≤ 1 μ-a.e. If ∫⟨g(x), ν(x)⟩ dμ(x) = ∫⟨g(x), ν'(x)⟩ dμ(x) for every continuous g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U, then ν = ν' μ-a.e.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν ν' : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ν' μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν' x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν' x) ∂μ) → ν =ᵐ[μ] ν'
